# MERLIN project instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before making changes, together with [project context](../docs/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md), [hackathon requirements](../docs/HACKATHON.md), and [current status](../docs/STATUS.md). Read [model notes](../docs/MODELS.md) for AI, voice, vision, or cost work.

The owner requires intentional project changes to be committed and pushed to GitHub unless explicitly told otherwise. Keep the shared documents current and distinguish implemented behavior from proposals. If this interface cannot commit or push, report that limitation so the work can be delivered through an interface that can.
